title: Haim Eshed claims US astronauts and aliens in underground Mars bases

tellings.quote: In 2020, Him Eched, former head of Israel's defense ministry's space directorate, essentially the father of the Israeli space program, publicly claimed that American astronauts and alien representatives were operating on underground bases on Mars.

plain: In 2020, Haim Eshed, the former head of the space directorate of Israel's defence ministry and, in Michels's words, essentially the father of the Israeli space program, publicly claimed that American astronauts and alien representatives were working together at underground bases on Mars. Michels tells it himself as a public statement Eshed made, notable because it came from such a senior figure.
